title: Isibonakaliso Phakathi Kwamatshe
intro: Ezweni lapho izintaba zaziqoshwe khona zibe yizindlu, kwafika isithunywa nesibonakaliso esimangalisayo esivela ku-Allah. Abantu bafuna ubufakazi, futhi bathola isidalwa esivela edwaleni eliqinile. Kodwa ukuzikhukhumeza kwabo kwabaholela ekubeni bangalaleli isixwayiso, kwavala isiphetho sabo.
clues: Ngathunyelwa kubantu ababehlala ezindaweni zokuhlala eziqoshwe ezintabeni.
Bangiphonsela inselelo yokuthi ngilethe isibonakaliso, ngakho ngaveza ikamela edwaleni.
Ngabayala ukuba bavumele ikamela liphuze ngokukhululeka futhi bangalilimazi.
Abalalelanga futhi banquma ikamela imisipha, bephula isixwayiso sami.
Ngamemezela ukuthi isijeziso sizofika ngemva kwezinsuku ezintathu.
Ekuseni, ukuqhuma okukhulu kwababhubhisa, kodwa mina nabalandeli bami sasinda.
arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَـٰلِحًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَإِذَا هُمْ فَرِيقَانِ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
verse: And We had certainly sent to Thamūd their brother Ṣāliḥ, [saying], "Worship Allāh," and at once they were two parties conflicting. (27:45)
